hypothesis: Adding a day-of-week feature lets the FM capture recurring temporal preference patterns and improves validation primary.

description: Train the existing FM with exactly one added categorical feature. The Docker workspace contains only train/valid dates; the official evaluator remains outside the container.
result_compare: Compare the candidate validation GAUC, nDCG@5, and primary against the FM baseline primary of 0.6016.
next_steps: Keep the feature only if primary improves beyond the baseline and the gain is meaningful; otherwise revert it and test a different hypothesis.
